The system must execute scoring logic within a bounded time threshold suitable for synchronous API usage.

epics.name: Pipeline Management
epics.goal: Reliable, managed, state-filtered provider data pipeline with proper lifecycle management
epics.definition_of_done: Pipeline runs end-to-end for specified states, enriches in-place, handles incremental updates, releases cluster on success or failure

features.name: Pipeline Lifecycle and Error Handling
features.description: Every pipeline step must accept state filter, report status on completion/failure, and release cluster reservation in a finally block. The orchestrator must handle abends gracefully.

stories.title: BUG-PIPE-001: State filter explicit in every enrichment step
stories.description: Every enrichment step (Pass 1-6) must accept and apply the states filter from the job config. No step should process records outside the specified states.

requirements.requirement: Every enrichment pass (1-6) must accept a states parameter and filter queries to only process providers in those states.
If states is not provided, the step must raise an error, not default to all records.

stories.title: BUG-PIPE-002: Try/finally with status report and reservation release
stories.description: Every orchestrator step must be wrapped in try/finally. The finally block must report completion status (success/fail) and release the cluster reservation if the job is terminal.

requirements.requirement: The full_provider_pipeline_orchestrator must wrap all steps in try/finally. On any failure, the finally block must release the reservation.
Each step must report status (completed_success or completed_fail) to the orchestrator.
On abend, the orchestrator must inform the manager to withdraw its reservation and shut down the cluster if no other jobs hold reservations.

stories.title: BUG-PIPE-003: Drop collection unless incremental=true
stories.description: The load step must drop the providers collection before loading unless the input parameter incremental=true is explicitly set. The Router API must accept incremental as a parameter.

requirements.requirement: The Router API must accept an incremental parameter (boolean, default false) in the FullProviderPipeline payload.
If incremental is false or absent, the providers collection must be dropped before loading new data.
If incremental is true, existing records are updated in-place per ENH-PIPE-001.

features.name: Provider Data Model — In-Place Enrichment
features.description: BUG-PIPE-004: Provider and enrichment data must be one record. Enrichment updates fields on the provider record in-place. No separate enrichment collection. Per MongoDB best practices — avoid cross-collection joins.

stories.title: BUG-PIPE-004: Enrichment in-place on provider record
stories.description: County enrichment, economic enrichment, and embedding must write directly to the provider record. No separate enriched collection. One document per provider, enrichment adds fields.

requirements.requirement: All enrichment (county, economic, embedding) must use updateOne/updateMany on the providers collection. No separate enrichment collection.

features.name: Incremental Provider Updates
features.description: Support incremental NPI file updates: full record replacement with county reset, and record deletion for deactivated NPIs.

stories.title: ENH-PIPE-001: Incremental update — full record replacement
stories.description: When incremental=true, for each record in the NPI file: replace the entire provider document content and set county to null (force re-enrichment). Do not attempt partial field updates — full replacement is more performant.

requirements.requirement: When incremental=true, each provider record must be fully replaced (replaceOne) with the new NPI data.
On incremental replace, county must be set to null to force re-enrichment in subsequent passes.
New records not already in the collection must be inserted.

stories.title: ENH-PIPE-002: Incremental deactivation — flag out_of_scope
stories.description: When the incremental NPI file marks a record as deactivated, flag it out_of_scope with reason deactivated. Do not delete. Log for audit.

requirements.requirement: Deactivated NPI numbers must be logged for audit trail.

features.name: Provider Data Quality — Bad Data and Out of Scope Flags
features.description: Replace the single county.source='out_of_scope' pattern with two explicit flags on the provider record: bad_data (data quality issues) and out_of_scope (good record but not in scope). Each has a controlled vocabulary of reasons. Queries decide inclusion/exclusion based on reason.

stories.title: Bad data flag with controlled reasons
stories.description: Add bad_data field to provider record: {flagged: bool, reason: controlled_value}. Controlled reasons: no_address (no address at all), bad_address (has address but wrong — zip/state mismatch repair failed). Replace county.source='out_of_scope' with reason='no_address' or 'zip_state_mismatch' with bad_data flag.

requirements.requirement: Provider record must have bad_data.flagged (boolean) and bad_data.reason (string from controlled vocabulary)
Controlled reasons: no_address, bad_address, zip_state_mismatch, zip_state_mismatch_multiple_licenses, zip_state_mismatch_no_license
Downstream queries must be able to include/exclude bad records based on reason

stories.title: Out of scope flag with controlled reasons
stories.description: Add out_of_scope field to provider record: {flagged: bool, reason: controlled_value}. Controlled reasons: deactivated (NPI deactivated), foreign_provider (not US). These are good records that are outside our processing scope.

requirements.requirement: Provider record must have out_of_scope.flagged (boolean) and out_of_scope.reason (string from controlled vocabulary)
Controlled reasons: deactivated, foreign_provider
out_of_scope records are not enriched or embedded but are not deleted

stories.title: Zip/state mismatch repair from license data
stories.description: When zip/state mismatch is detected, attempt repair using provider license state data before flagging bad_data. One license match: repair address. Multiple licenses: bad_data.reason=zip_state_mismatch_multiple_licenses. No license: bad_data.reason=zip_state_mismatch_no_license. License doesn't resolve: bad_data.reason=zip_state_mismatch.

requirements.requirement: On zip/state mismatch, check provider license state(s) to determine correct state
If exactly one license state matches, repair practice_address.state and clear bad_data flag
If multiple licenses, flag bad_data.reason=zip_state_mismatch_multiple_licenses
If no license data, flag bad_data.reason=zip_state_mismatch_no_license
If license doesn't resolve, flag bad_data.reason=zip_state_mismatch
